title: Copilot Evaluation Harness: Evaluating LLM-Guided Software Programming
reasoning: The paper introduces an evaluation harness for LLM-guided software programming. Its evaluation scenarios and metrics (documentation generation, bug fixing, code generation, test case generation, workspace understanding) do not include a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics. While other works on ethics are referenced, this paper does not perform such an evaluation itself.
